blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **ска́зка** — (literary genre) tale; fairy tale. Wiktionary: сказа́ть + -ка.
**оста́ток** — remainder, rest, residue, remnant. Wiktionary: оста́ться + -ок.
**ко́нчик** — tip, point, cusp (extreme top of something). Wiktionary: коне́ц + -ик.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: tip, point, cusp (extreme top of something)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ска́зка — (literary genre) tale; fairy tale; старичок — little old man; оста́ток — remainder, rest, residue, remnant; ко́нчик — tip, point, cusp (extreme top of something).
**нахо́дка** — find, discovery (anything that is found, especially by good fortune). Wiktionary: находи́ть + -ка.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: find, discovery (anything that is found, especially by good fortune)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́ходка — trick, prank; улы́бка — smile; нахо́дка — find, discovery (anything that is found, especially by good fortune); привы́чка — habit, custom.
